source: AER 360 Spec 109 as built (aeredium/AERAccounts, commit e2dcc6e, pull request #126): the payloads its own suite recorded and printed in the pull request — the 202, the ceremonies read for A, B and a viewer, the sign bodies, the finish, the audit rows of a two-person finish, the card's sentences and the refusals — with the harness's own people (Harriet Founder the author and WO2's third party, Ada Approver and Ben Signatory the two WA1 names, Olive Overseer the viewer) in place of the suite's, and the harness's account name in place of the suite's. Every field, status word and sentence is the estate's; the ids are the suite's run. No name from a customer estate travels here.
